failure_analysis: All trials passed all 7 hidden cases, with no `_doing_it_wrong` records. The docs did well on the exact risks this task exercises: the Tag Processor overview clearly says it is appropriate for flat, byte-preserving edits; the `Building markup from a template` section explicitly explains using a literal template, predeclaring attributes to preserve order, and inserting placeholder text so `set_modifiable_text()` has a token to replace; `set_attribute()` and `set_modifiable_text()` both state that callers should provide plain unescaped strings and the API handles encoding. Near-misses were minimal: none of the candidates checked the boolean return from `set_modifiable_text()`, but because they first required `get_token_type() === '#text'` in a known complete template, that omission did not create a practical failure here.
